tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground behind everything on screen. Also the text colour of the primary button.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the top bar, the form pane, the sticky status line.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The pane a paper sheet sits on, one step lighter than panel so the white sheet has a frame.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Structural borders: under the top bar, between panes, above the status line, the dashed rule between items.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input underlines and the textarea box at rest. 1.4:1 on panel, under the 3:1 a control border should have in the source; a field is found by its label and by the text border it takes on focus.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decoration only: the /* ----- comment rules around section heads and the dotted leader in the top bar. Never for text.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on panel. 2.0:1, below 4.5:1 in the source: keep placeholders to hints, never to instructions.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and panel: field labels, resting buttons, the status line, counters. 3.7:1 on panel and 3.9:1 on bg, under 4.5:1 for 11-12px text in the source; never put anything the reader must read in dim alone.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on bg and panel, and the focused input border. 15.9:1 on panel.

tokens.name: hi
tokens.usage: Emphasis on bg and panel: input values, section heads, the selected bracket button, totals. Also the fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: The primary button's fill on hover, with bg text on it (10.9:1).

tokens.name: frame-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px ring that outlines a paper sheet against stage.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The A4 sheet. Printed documents are always ink on paper, whatever the screen theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and rules on paper. 18.9:1.

tokens.name: paper-detail
tokens.usage: Item detail lines on paper (Editorial). 12.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: paper-label
tokens.usage: Small labels on paper (Editorial, Mono). 7.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: paper-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: the qty × rate aside, labels in Grotesk and Receipt. 4.48:1 on paper, a hair under 4.5:1 in the source.

tokens.name: paper-rule
tokens.usage: Light rules between rows on paper; the heavy rule above a total is ink.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything on screen is one size: values, buttons, the status line.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heads, in hi, written as a shell prompt: ~ $ NAME.

styles.name: strong
styles.usage: The one thing in a row that names it, like an item's description.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in dim, and detail lines under an item.

styles.name: gr-body
styles.usage: 9pt in print. Everything on a Grotesk sheet that is not a headline.

styles.name: gr-big
styles.usage: 26pt. The sender's name, the document's name and section titles.

styles.name: gr-num
styles.usage: 58pt. The document number, once per sheet.

styles.name: rc-body
styles.sample: Recibí de … la cantidad de MXN 194,508.00
styles.usage: 11pt. The one sentence a receipt is built around.

styles.name: gr-tiny
styles.usage: 5pt. Reference data beside the big number, and the footer note.

styles.name: ed-body
styles.usage: 9.5pt. Item names (at 600) and details on an Editorial sheet.

styles.name: ed-mark
styles.usage: 22pt. The sender's initials, split to the two edges.

styles.name: ed-due
styles.usage: 11pt. The one line that says what is owed and when.

styles.name: ed-sans
styles.usage: 6.8pt Inter. Contact lines, table heads and totals.

styles.name: mo-body
styles.usage: 6.5pt Inter. Labels and prose on a Mono sheet.

styles.name: mo-m
styles.usage: 8.5pt IBM Plex Mono. Every value: addresses, dates, numbers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a bracket button (2px 4px), between bracket buttons in a switch, label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding, chip gap, input vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between items in the top bar, primary button side padding, textarea side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Row gap in a field grid, gap inside an item head, margin above chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Status line vertical padding, the gap after a switch.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top bar vertical padding, space under a section head.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap in a field grid, item number gaps, the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top bar side padding, gap between status entries.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Indent of an item's detail and numbers, past its 01 counter.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Pane padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner. Nothing in this system is rounded; inputs reset the browser's radius to 0.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The paper sheet on stage, and only that. Screen UI never casts a shadow.
